weapon_contract.long_blade_overlay_policy: caster-follow effects extend the active blade outside the compact actor frame

body_source_contract.body_processing: none; exact final 1x RGBA byte copy

native_actor.pack_time_resampling: none; 67 exact-size V7 RGBA PNGs are copied byte-for-byte; native rectangles stay immutable and custom frames occupy only the atlas extension

runtime_w_resolution.shape: one stationary caster-following crescent plus one stateless native 80-degree, 42000-range forward cone scan
runtime_w_resolution.damage: 35 + 45% Attack + 6% target maximum HP physical damage from the same cone snapshot
runtime_w_resolution.shield: the same native cone snapshot grants one 90-tick 50 + 20% Attack shield after any enemy hit, then scales through every enemy champion hit up to the normal five-champion team limit
runtime_w_resolution.state: no process-global W ledger; hit collection, damage, champion count, and shield tier resolve in one GameCtx callback
runtime_w_resolution.attack_speed_limitation: Mod API 0.8 exposes neither aggregate attack speed nor per-skill dynamic cast/cooldown mutation, so the disclosed 30/480-tick values remain fixed

face_readability.policy: from-zero dual-sword V7 body model; all final 1x frames are generated once, palette-audited, then copied byte-for-byte with no pack-time resize or repaint

idle_face_contract.view: readable chibi portrait with source-authored eye-outline cue pixels

ui_source_direct.resampling: one uniform LANCZOS shrink per destination; never NEAREST enlargement
ui_source_direct.card_paste: 85x93 fullbody pasted 1:1 at x=28/y=0 into 141x138 card
ui_source_direct.card_name_layer: not rasterized in QA; runtime localized name is drawn by the engine text layer

retired_body_routes.v3: retired and never used as a fallback
retired_body_routes.v4_status: both V4 ImageGen body sources and the entire old native route are retired; build_actor loads only dual-sword-v7
retired_body_routes.v5_status: all V5 ImageGen/native body inputs are retired negative-contract paths; build_actor loads only dual-sword-v7
retired_body_routes.v6_battle_status: old V6 battle contacts and native frames are physically retired; the former high-resolution V6 UI portrait source is provenance only

large_vfx_policy: Q3 tornado/knockup, compact W crescent/shield, and R feedback are isolated in dedicated sheets; no large effect replaces Yone's actor body.

portrait_policy.default_runtime: four independent source-direct V7 UI textures; no battle-atlas portrait input
portrait_policy.fullbody: 85x93 exact champion_slot destination, <=70x82 subject, alpha bottom y<=86
portrait_policy.scoreboard: 48x64 source-direct upper-body crop, <=40x54 subject, alpha bottom y<=60
portrait_policy.grid: 90x122 full body, alpha ends at or before y=86, name band begins y=96
